verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.

verses.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

segments.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

verses.text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

segments.text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

verses.text: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.

segments.text: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.

verses.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

segments.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

verses.text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.

segments.text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.

verses.text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

segments.text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

verses.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.

segments.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.

verses.text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.

segments.text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.

verses.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.

segments.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
